title: Find and replace
summary: Replace every exact occurrence of a text with another.

sections.use: Replace every occurrence of an exact piece of text, such as a renamed product or a corrected figure, and report how many were replaced.
sections.exclusions: Not for patterns, case-insensitive or whole-word matching: it matches literally, character for character. Not for rewording; use a model block.
sections.limitations: Text up to 1 MiB; find and replace up to 1,000 characters. Matches are left to right and never overlap. The block omits expected_count; edit the block to require an exact count.
sections.missing_data: No match is a result: the text is returned unchanged with count 0.
sections.effects: Runs locally inside AgentWiz with no network access, files or model; it only returns a value. It has no destination, so it can run on Local only data; its output is restricted whenever an input is.
sections.failures: A refusal names a fixed code and, where it applies, a 1-based position (record, row or entry); the message never repeats your text. Check the input against the limits above and run again.

inputs.replace: The text to put in its place; may be empty to delete.

outputs.out: The changed text and the number of replacements (count).
